title: Shared Understanding in Human-AI Teams: Coordination Continuity in Evolving Work
abstract: arXiv:2611.27746v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: People are increasingly working with AI agents as part of extended, asynchronous workflows. In these settings, shared access to information does not guarantee a shared basis for action: goals, plans, and roles may persist while their current significance changes. We introduce coordination continuity, the extent to which collaborators sustain a workable basis for interdependent action as work progresses. Drawing on research on collaborative work, along with two qualitative team studies and a reflexive case from our own repository-based environment, we present a framework of three elements: durable representations of collaborative work; relative coordination properties that support interpretation of representations in the moment; and interaction mechanisms through which the status of representations can be understood and altered. translated_title: 人机团队中的共享理解：演进工作中的协调连续性
translated_abstract: 人们越来越多地将AI智能体作为扩展的异步工作流程的一部分来协同工作。在这些场景中，对信息的共享访问并不保证行动的共同基础：目标、计划和角色可能持续存在，但其当前的意义却在不断变化。我们提出了“协调连续性”这一概念，即协作者在工作推进过程中维持可运作的相互依赖行动基础的程度。基于协作工作领域的研究，以及两项定性团队研究和来自我们自身基于仓库的环境中的一个反思性案例，我们提出了一个包含三个要素的框架：协作工作的持久表示；支持对表示进行即时解释的相对协调属性；以及能够理解和改变表示状态的交互机制。我们运用“构建-行动-漂移-重建”的启发式方法以及“关键性时刻”的概念来刻画何时需要重建……
tldr: 该论文提出“协调连续性”这一新概念，并构建了由持久表示、相对协调属性和交互机制三要素组成的框架，用以解释人机团队如何在演进的异步工作中持续维持相互依赖行动的共同基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "coordination continuity" and presents a three-element framework—durable representations, relative coordination properties, and interaction mechanisms—to explain how human-AI teams sustain a workable basis for interdependent action as work evolves.
